title: The Red Inn
author: Honoré de Balzac
description: "The Red Inn" by Honoré de Balzac is a short story published in 1831.
longDescription: At a Parisian dinner party, a guest recounts a chilling tale from 1799 Germany: two young French doctors and a wealthy merchant spend the night at an inn, where one doctor contemplates murder. By morning, the merchant lies dead, and an innocent man faces execution.

authorInfo.bio: Honoré de Balzac was a French novelist and playwright. The novel sequence La Comédie humaine, described as a panorama of post-Napoleonic French life, is generally viewed as his magnum opus.
